# B2 Read it in

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

read_hh <- function(zip_file) {
  keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
            "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
            "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

  hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
  unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped")

  site_id <- sub(".*_(.*?)_FLUXNET.*", "\\1", basename(zip_file))

  hh <- read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
                 na = "-9999",
                 col_select = any_of(keep),
                 col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d")) |>
    mutate(
      time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
      ID = site_id
    )
  
  return(hh)
}

```


```{r}
US_Ro5 <- read_hh("data/raw/AMF_US-Ro5_FLUXNET_2017-2024_v1.3_r1.zip")
Be_Maa <- read_hh("data/raw/ICOS_BE-Maa_FLUXNET_2016-2026_v1.3_r1.zip")
DE_Hzd <- read_hh("data/raw/ICOS_DE-Hzd_FLUXNET_2010-2025_v1.3_r1.zip")
JP_Ta2 <- read_hh("data/raw/JPF_JP-Ta2_FLUXNET_2005-2015_v1.3_r1.zip")
```

```{r}
Alltowers <- rbind(US_Ro5,Be_Maa,DE_Hzd,JP_Ta2,NZ_Add)
```

```{r}
read_all_hh <- function(zip_dir = "data/raw", pattern = "FLUXNET.*\\.zip$") {
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  
  keep <- c("TIMESTAMP_START", "TIMESTAMP_END", "TA_F", "SW_IN_F", "VPD_F", "P_F",
            "NETRAD", "G_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS", "H_F_MDS_QC", "LE_F_MDS", "LE_F_MDS_QC",
            "NEE_VUT_REF", "NEE_VUT_REF_QC", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")

  
  zip_files <- list.files(zip_dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(zip_files) == 0) {
    stop("No zipfiles in folder.")
  }
  

  hh_list <- lapply(zip_files, function(zip_file) {
    hh_name <- grep("FLUXMET_HH", unzip(zip_file, list = TRUE)$Name, value = TRUE)
    unzip(zip_file, files = hh_name, exdir = "data/raw/unzipped")
    
    site_id <- sub(".*_(.*?)_FLUXNET.*", "\\1", basename(zip_file))
    
    read_csv(file.path("data/raw/unzipped", hh_name),
             na = "-9999",
             col_select = any_of(keep),
             col_types = cols(TIMESTAMP_START = "c", TIMESTAMP_END = "c", .default = "d")) |>
      mutate(
        time = as.POSIXct(TIMESTAMP_START, format = "%Y%m%d%H%M", tz = "UTC"),
        ID = site_id
      )
  })
  
  
  Alltowers <- bind_rows(hh_list)
  
  return(Alltowers)
}

Alltowers <- read_all_hh()

Alltowers[Alltowers == -9999] <- NA


```

# 1. Location of the flux towers

```{r}
library(leaflet)

stations <- data.frame(
  ID = c("US-Ro5", "BE-Maa", "DE-Hzd", "JP-Ta2", "NZ-ADd"),
  lat = c(44.691, 50.980, 50.964, 36.140, -43.644),  
  lon = c(-93.058, 5.632, 13.490, 137.371, 172.355),
  ecosystem = c("Cropland","closed shrubland", "Decidous broadleaf forest", "Evergreen needleleaf forest", "Grassland"),
  Years = c("2017-2024","2016-2026", "2016-2025","2005-2015", "2016-2020")
)

leaflet(stations) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = 1,
    color = "red",
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    label = ~paste0(ID, "<br>Lat: ", lat, "<br>Lon: ", lon)
  ) %>%
  fitBounds(min(stations$lon), min(stations$lat),
            max(stations$lon), max(stations$lat))

```

```{r}
Alltowers <- Alltowers %>%

```
```{r}

```


# Summary statistics


```{r}
summary_table <- Alltowers %>% 
  group_by(ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    across(c(TA_F, SW_IN_F, VPD_F, NEE_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF, RECO_NT_VUT_REF, H_F_MDS, LE_F_MDS), 
           list(
             Mean = ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             Missing_pct = ~ sum(is.na(.x)) / n() * 100
           ), .names = "{.col} ({.fn})"),
    P_F_annual_sum = sum(P_F, na.rm = TRUE) * 24 * 365,
    P_F_min = min(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_max = max(P_F, na.rm = TRUE),
    P_F_missing_pct = sum(is.na(P_F)) / n() * 100
  )

colnames(summary_table) <- c(
  "Site (ID)",
  "TA_F (°C) Mean", "TA_F (°C) Min", "TA_F (°C) Max", "TA_F (%) Missing",
  "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Mean", "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Min", "SW_IN_F (W/m²) Max", "SW_IN_F (%) Missing",
  "VPD_F (kPa) Mean", "VPD_F (kPa) Min", "VPD_F (kPa) Max", "VPD_F (%) Missing",
  "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Mean", "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Min", "NEE_VUT_REF (µmol/m²/s) Max", "NEE_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Mean", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Min", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Max", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Mean", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Min", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (gC/m²/day) Max", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF (%) Missing",
  "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Mean", "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Min", "H_F_MDS (W/m²) Max", "H_F_MDS (%) Missing",
  "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Mean", "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Min", "LE_F_MDS (W/m²) Max", "LE_F_MDS (%) Missing",
  "P_F (mm) Annual Sum", "P_F (mm) Min", "P_F (mm) Max", "P_F (%) Missing"
)

summary_table
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

Alltowers_daily <- Alltowers %>% 
  mutate(date = ymd_hm(TIMESTAMP_START)) %>% 
  group_by(date = as.Date(date), ID) %>% 
  summarise(
    NEE_daily = mean(NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    GPP_daily = mean(GPP_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    RECO_daily = mean(RECO_NT_VUT_REF, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.0378,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

Alltowers_daily_long <- Alltowers_daily %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(NEE_daily, GPP_daily, RECO_daily), 
               names_to = "Variable", 
               values_to = "Value")

ggplot(Alltowers_daily_long, aes(x = date, y = Value, color = Variable)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(~ ID) + 
  labs(title = "Daily NEE, GPP, and RECO", 
       x = "Date", 
       y = "g C m⁻² d⁻¹") + 
  theme_minimal()

```
